Great decisions start with trusted data. In this role, you will help build the enterprise reporting and analytics engine that gives UL Solutions leaders the clarity to see performance, act faster, and run the business with confidence.
As Lead Finance Data Analyst - Enterprise Performance Reporting, you will turn complex financial, operational, and business data into executive-ready dashboards, KPI frameworks, and self-service analytics that improve decisions across the enterprise.
This is a high-impact role for someone who can connect the dots between data, business performance, and leadership action.
This is a full-time hybrid position (3 days per week in office) located at either our Northbrook, IL or Chicago, IL office.
Enterprise Reporting & Dashboard Development
+ Build executive dashboards, scorecards, enterprise reports, and KPI frameworks that leaders use to run the business.
+ Standardize financial and operational metrics so reporting is consistent, trusted, and scalable.
+ Design clear, intuitive reporting experiences that make performance easy to understand and act on.
+ Partner with Finance and business teams to deliver reporting solutions that solve real business needs.
+ Support management and executive reporting packages with timely, relevant insights.
Data Analytics & Insights
+ Analyze financial, operational, and business data to uncover trends, risks, opportunities, and performance drivers.
+ Translate analysis into practical recommendations that help leaders move faster and make better decisions.
+ Strengthen enterprise KPI structures and performance measurement practices.
Data Management & Reporting Solutions
+ Bring together data from multiple systems and make it usable, reliable, and ready for reporting.
+ Maintain reporting datasets and catalogs as trusted enterprise information sources.
+ Improve data preparation, automation, and visualization to reduce manual effort and increase speed.
+ Promote data quality, accuracy, and consistency across reporting processes.
+ Work with IT and data teams to improve architecture, integration, and access to trusted data.
Analytics Product Development
+ Define, build, and launch reporting and analytics products that scale across the enterprise.
+ Create self-service dashboards that give teams faster access to the answers they need.
+ Drive adoption and continuous improvement of enterprise analytics capabilities.
+ Identify opportunities to increase automation, efficiency, and business value.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
+ Collaborate with Accounting, FP&A, Operations, IT, and business leaders to align reporting with enterprise priorities.
+ Present insights clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
+ Build alignment by connecting data insights to business decisions.
+ Serve as a trusted advisor on reporting, performance measurement, and analytics practices.
+ Coach analysts and business partners involved in reporting and analytics initiatives.
Governance & Compliance
+ Promote reporting standards, metric consistency, and data governance best practices.
+ Document KPI definitions, reporting methodologies, and business rules.
+ Follow the UL Solutions Code of Conduct and all physical and digital security requirements.
+ Perform other duties as assigned.
Required
+ Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Analytics, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Information Systems, or related field.
+ 5+ years of experience in business analytics, enterprise reporting, BI, financial reporting, performance management, or related work.
+ Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Power BI and Microsoft Excel.
+ Experience working with large, complex datasets.
+ Strong data management, integration, and analysis skills.
+ Ability to organize, analyze, validate, and connect information from multiple sources.
+ Strong communication and presentation skills for technical and non-technical audiences.
+ Experience creating dashboards, scorecards, executive reporting, and analytical solutions.
+ Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and stakeholder management skills.
Preferred
+ Experience supporting Finance, FP&A, Accounting, EPM, or performance reporting functions.
+ Experience with ERP, EPM, enterprise reporting platforms, SQL, data modeling, or automation tools.
+ Experience developing KPI frameworks and management reporting processes.
+ Knowledge of financial and operational performance metrics.
+ Experience supporting executive reporting and decision support.
+ Experience working in a global, matrixed organization.
What Success Looks Like
+ Success means building reporting capabilities that make performance easier to see, understand, and improve, including:
+ Consistent executive and management reporting built on standardized KPIs.
Why Join the Enterprise Performance Reporting Team?
Join a team helping UL Solutions strengthen how the enterprise measures performance, tells the story behind the numbers, and turns insight into action.
If you enjoy building scalable reporting solutions, partnering with senior stakeholders, and making data more useful to the business, this role offers a visible opportunity to shape enterprise performance reporting.
+ Clearer visibility into financial and operational performance.
+ Faster access to trusted insights and self-service analytics.
+ Less manual reporting through automation and standardization.
+ Better business decisions across the enterprise.
Total Rewards: We understand compensation is an important factor as you consider the next step in your career. The estimated salary range for this position is $150,000 - $175,000 and is based on multiple factors, including job-related knowledge/skills, experience, geographical location, as well as other factors. This position is eligible for annual bonus compensation with a target payout of 20% of the base salary. This position also provides health benefits such as medical, dental and vision; wellness benefits such as mental and financial health; and retirement savings (401K) commensurate with the standard rewards offered in each individual location or country. We also provide full-time employees with paid time off including vacation (15 days), holiday and personal days (totaling 12 days), and sick time off (72 hours).

Job Description  
  
The Marketing Data Analyst will work at a global bank to support a Data 360 implementation initiative, working alongside an external consulting firm and internal teams to demonstrate how centralized customer data can enable more personalized, multi-channel marketing experiences.  
  
This person will:  
Analyze customer and marketing data across existing on-premise systems to support Data 360 use cases.  
Help bring data together to create a more centralized view of the customer.  
Partner with marketing, data, technology, and consulting teams to define and stand up high-value marketing use cases.  
Analyze customer behaviors, audiences, and campaign performance to identify opportunities for more targeted engagement.  
Support the development of triggered customer journeys across multiple channels, expanding beyond email.  
Validate and QA data used within each use case to ensure insights and targeting are accurate.  
Translate data findings into clear insights that marketing stakeholders and leadership can easily understand.  
Help demonstrate the business value of Data 360 through tangible use cases that can drive leadership buy-in and broader adoption.  
  
Breakdown of responsibilities:  
1\. Journey Development & Analytics  
• Partner with Marketing and Analytics stakeholders to understand business objectives, campaign strategies, customer journeys, and targeting requirements.  
• Translate marketing requirements into clearly defined audience selection and journey logic, including:  
o Customer eligibility criteria  
o Inclusion and exclusion rules  
o Trigger/event logic  
o Product and customer segmentation  
o Channel eligibility  
o Contact and suppression rules  
o Journey entry and exit criteria  
o Prioritization and sequencing logic  
• Conduct data discovery and feasibility assessments to determine whether required customer attributes, behaviors, and events are available within existing data environments.  
• Identify appropriate source systems, tables, fields, and business logic required to enable journeys.  
• Perform exploratory analysis and customer sizing to support journey design and business decisions.  
• Support enhancements and ongoing optimization of existing journeys as business requirements evolve.  
2\. Technical Specification Development  
• Develop comprehensive technical specifications (Tech Specs) that translate business requirements into implementation-ready data and decisioning logic.  
• Document:  
o Source tables and data elements  
o Field definitions and transformations  
o Join logic and customer identifiers  
o Eligibility and exclusion criteria  
o Segmentation rules  
o Calculated fields and derived attributes  
o Trigger/event definitions  
o Refresh frequencies and applicable lookback periods  
o Data dependencies and upstream/downstream impacts  
• Ensure technical requirements are clearly documented so technology and implementation teams can build the required audience, data, and journey components with minimal ambiguity.  
• Maintain appropriate documentation and version control as journey requirements evolve.  
3\. Data Analysis & SQL Development  
• Develop and validate complex SQL queries to support data discovery, audience creation, sizing, and journey logic.  
• Analyze large customer and transactional datasets to validate business assumptions and determine data availability.  
• Reconcile customer populations across source systems and investigate discrepancies.  
• Create prototype logic and analytical datasets that can be transitioned into production implementation.  
• Identify data-quality limitations and recommend practical solutions or alternative approaches.  
4\. Testing, Validation & Implementation Support  
• Partner with Technology, Data, Campaign Execution, and Marketing teams throughout implementation.  
• Develop test scenarios and expected results based on documented requirements.  
• Conduct UAT and data validation to ensure implemented logic correctly reflects approved technical specifications.  
• Perform record-level validation of customer eligibility, exclusions, segmentation, and journey triggers.  
• Troubleshoot implementation issues by tracing data through source systems and transformation logic.  
• Support production readiness and post-implementation validation.  
5\. Governance & Documentation  
• Ensure journey and technical specification documentation meets established data governance, risk management, and documentation standards.  
• Maintain clear traceability between business requirements, technical logic, data sources, and implemented solutions.  
• Document assumptions, dependencies, limitations, and business decisions.  
• Support remediation activities where documentation or technical specifications require enhancement.  
• Develop reusable approaches and standards that improve consistency across future journey development.  
6\. Stakeholder & Cross-Functional Collaboration  
• Serve as a key analytical liaison between Marketing, Marketing Analytics, Technology, Data, and Campaign Execution teams.  
• Translate technical concepts into clear business language and business requirements into detailed technical requirements.  
• Proactively identify requirement gaps, data constraints, dependencies, or potential implementation risks.  
• Participate in journey design sessions, requirement walkthroughs, technical reviews, and implementation discussions.  
• Manage multiple journey and Tech Spec deliverables while meeting agreed timelines and priorities.

+ Experience utilizing and developing within Snowflake services

**Summary**

The Sr Data Analyst supports the PMO by turning structured and unstructured data into actionable insights that drive program decision-making.

This position will be responsible for collecting, analyzing, interpreting, and presenting operational, financial, supply chain, and customer performance data to support business decisions, improve operational efficiency, and proactively identify risks affecting customer commitments.

The ideal candidate will possess strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate complex data from multiple business systems into actionable insights, meaningful performance metrics, and management dashboards.

A key focus of this role is to move beyond traditional reporting and provide **forward-looking analysis**, particularly in identifying customer orders at risk of late delivery due to supplier constraints, material shortages, manufacturing delays, regulatory approvals, and other operational challenges.

The Data Analyst will collaborate closely with Program Management, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Finance, Quality, Customer Service, and the Sales, Inventory & Operations Planning (SIOP) Manager to improve visibility, accountability, and business performance.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

The essential duties and responsibilities include the following, other duties as may be required from time-to-time.

**Operational Performance Metrics & KPI Management**

* Develop, maintain, and continuously improve operational dashboards and key performance indicators (KPIs).
* Monitor and analyze key performance metrics, including:
    * Customer on-time delivery (OTD)
    * Supplier on-time delivery and delivery commitments
    * Shipping accuracy
    * Customer order entry accuracy
    * Customer satisfaction and complaints
    * Manufacturing schedule adherence
    * Order backlog and past-due orders
    * Repair turnaround time (TAT)
    * Product quality, defects, and field failure trends
    * Inventory accuracy, aging, and turnover
    * Program profitability and gross margins
* Identify performance trends, recurring issues, and improvement opportunities.
* Prepare weekly, monthly, and quarterly performance reports for management reviews.
* Establish standardized KPI definitions, calculation methodologies, and reporting practices.

**Open Order Analysis & Delivery Risk Management**

* Analyze customer sales orders, open order backlog, production schedules, inventory availability, and supplier commitments to identify potential delivery risks.
* Develop and maintain an **Open Order Risk Dashboard** that provides visibility into customer orders at risk of missing contractual delivery commitments.
* Correlate customer-requested delivery dates with:
    * Supplier purchase order commitments and expected receipt dates
    * Material availability and shortages
    * Manufacturing lead times and production schedules
    * Engineering and quality holds
    * Regulatory approval milestones, including PMA approval dates where applicable
    * Customer-specific delivery and documentation requirements
* Identify discrepancies between customer delivery requirements and material or production readiness.
* Highlight critical exceptions, delivery gaps, and potential schedule conflicts.
* Develop risk indicators and exception reports that categorize orders by severity, such as high, medium, and low delivery risk.
* Support Program Managers and Supply Chain in prioritizing mitigation actions and expediting activities.
* Track changes in supplier commitments and evaluate their downstream impact on customer deliveries.
* Provide forward-looking delivery projections and early-warning indicators to minimize late shipments.

**Supply Chain & Supplier Performance Analytics**

* Monitor supplier performance, including on-time delivery, lead-time reliability, quality trends, and commitment accuracy.
* Analyze purchase order schedules, supplier acknowledgments, and revised delivery commitments.
* Identify suppliers and components contributing to delivery risks and production disruptions.
* Evaluate supplier lead-time variability and its impact on customer order fulfillment.
* Support Supply Chain in identifying recurring supplier performance issues and opportunities for improvement.
* Develop supplier scorecards and exception-based reporting.

**Financial Performance, Cost & Profitability Analysis**

* Partner with Finance and Program Management to monitor product and program financial performance.
* Analyze actual product costs against standard costs, budgets, and planned margins.
* Track gross margin performance by product, customer, and program.
* Identify cost variances, margin erosion, and unfavorable profitability trends.
* Analyze material cost increases, manufacturing costs, and repair costs.
* Support profitability analysis for production and aftermarket service programs.
* Develop financial dashboards to provide visibility into cost performance and improvement opportunities.

**Inventory Analytics & SIOP Support**

* Collaborate with the SIOP Manager to support the Sales, Inventory & Operations Planning process.
* Analyze inventory levels, demand forecasts, sales backlog, and material availability.
* Support demand and supply reconciliation by identifying gaps between customer requirements, available inventory, and supplier capacity.
* Monitor excess, obsolete, slow-moving, and aging inventory.
* Evaluate inventory turnover, days of supply, and inventory exposure.
* Provide analytical support for inventory optimization and working capital improvement initiatives.
* Support scenario modeling to assess the impact of demand changes, supplier delays, and production constraints.
* Prepare data and analysis for monthly SIOP reviews and management decision-making.

**Aftermarket Services & Repair Performance Analytics**

* Monitor repair turnaround time and performance against customer commitments.
* Analyze repair backlog, aging work orders, and overdue repairs.
* Identify bottlenecks in the repair process, including material shortages, testing constraints, and capacity limitations.
* Analyze repair costs, profitability, and recurring failure trends.
* Support the Aftermarket Services team in improving repair efficiency and customer satisfaction.
* Develop dashboards to monitor repair performance and service-level commitments.

 **Information Architecture & Continuous Improvement**

* Partner with Data Management Specialist to design, implement, and maintain the information architecture across Sharepoint, Microsoft Teams, network drives, and other collaboration platforms to ensure the information is intuitive, organized, and easily accessible.
* Contribute to process improvements related to data collection, reporting cadence, and analytical rigor across the PMO.
* Support the implementation and continuous improvement of Sharepoint, Microsoft Teams, Power BI, and other digital collaboration tools to improve organizational effectiveness.

* Bachelor's degree in Data Analytics, Business Analytics, Supply Chain Management, Industrial Engineering, Finance, Operations Management, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

Our global footprint produces inquiries from stakeholders that require complex answers. Questions can span years of data, multiple data stores and a variety of financial domains.

This is a reporting and analysis role at the intersection of finance, trading operations, and data engineering. The work is deadline-driven; your outputs go to regulatory authorities, external auditors, and firm leadership.

## What You'll Do

**Answer business questions with data**

* Build and run extracts against the firm's data stores to answer requests from the front office, and other units like Tax and Legal
* Drive improvements to market share reporting and analytics
* Support quarterly and annual tax and regulatory inquiries across multiple global jurisdictions
* Respond to audit, litigation, and class-action data requests, often under short turnaround

* Validate every extract before delivery — cross-foot detail against aggregates, reconcile against source systems, and investigate discrepancies rather than explaining them away
* Document the business rules behind each report, including who made the decision and why

**Reduce the recurring load**

* Identify patterns across incoming requests
* Partner with engineering teams to translate those patterns into durable solutions: reporting dashboards, self-service views, scheduled reports
* Write the specification: define the business logic, the edge cases, and the validation criteria that a tool needs to get right

* Experience specifying requirements for engineering teams, or building BI tooling (Tableau, Power BI, or similar)

Req ID: 160555

Category: Procurement

**Position Summary:**

**Senior Data Analyst – Data Infrastructure & Analytics - Strategic Sourcing**

Heartland Dental is the nation's largest dental support organization, providing non-clinical administrative support services to more than 3,200 supported doctors in over 2,000 dental offices across 38 states and the District of Columbia. Each Heartland Dental supported office is unique to the community and the patients they serve. Supported doctors are the leaders of their practice and retain clinical autonomy. All Heartland Dental supported Doctors are united by a common goal: delivering the highest quality dental care and experiences to the communities they serve.

The Senior Data Analyst leads data, analytics and business intelligence for Strategic Sourcing and owns our migration to Google Cloud Platform (GCP). The role turns purchasing data from over 2,000 supported offices into insights that sharpen sourcing strategy, strengthen supplier relationships and negotiations, and help leadership make data-driven decisions that enhance business and financial KPIs.

At the center of Strategic Sourcing's work with Category Managers, the Strategic Sourcing Program Manager, Finance, Accounts Payable, IT and Operations, this position provides the dashboards, analytics, models and reporting behind every sourcing decision, from spend baselines to savings tracking.

Serving as the technical liaison between Strategic Sourcing, IT, and our external technology and supply partners, from our purchasing platform to distributors, manufacturers and labs, the role defines data requirements and leads the technical conversations. This position also owns the team's data and analytics roadmap and keeps improving it with cloud data, automation and AI.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

#### What is the Developer Led Growth (DLG) Team?

At the heart of our mission is a simple goal: to make choosing and integrating authentication a delightful experience for every developer.

We're the **DLG team**; essentially Product Led Growth (PLG), but for developers using Auth0. We're a high-impact, multidisciplinary engine spanning **Developer Relations, Developer Marketing, our Startup Program, and Product Activation and Conversion**. We move metrics and build the journey that turns curious developers into lifelong advocates.

#### Why This Role?

**This role sits within the DLG team as part of a two-person data team,** where you'll have an experienced tech lead as your analytical partner, giving you both the autonomy to own your domain and the support to go deep on hard problems. The DLG team moves fast across many fronts, and this role is the analytical voice that keeps everyone aligned on key metrics. That means your ability to communicate clearly, whether you're presenting to a VP, syncing with a data engineer, or writing a Slack message that makes a complex finding land, this matters as much as your technical skills.

**You'll have real autonomy and a clear voice in what gets built.** Requests come from every direction across the DLG org, and while your tech lead manages the overall roadmap, you'll have genuine input into prioritization decisions and the freedom to push back when scope isn't right. As you grow in the role, so does your ownership. This is a place where strong opinions and good judgment get rewarded.

**You'll ask questions nobody else is asking.** The best work on this team doesn't come from running the report that was requested, it comes from finding the insight nobody thought to look for. We want someone who is genuinely curious and brings creative thinking to how they frame problems.

**You'll work at the frontier of AI-assisted analytics.** We're a team that actively uses AI tooling to move faster and think bigger. We expect you to use AI as a force multiplier, in how you write SQL, explore data, prototype models, and document your work.

**Responsibilities**

* Build and maintain **Tableau dashboards**, **Snowflake Streamlit** and **DBT models** that serve as the single source of truth for the DLG business
* Translate complex, cross-functional data into clear narratives and recommendations for stakeholders across product, marketing, sales, finance, and ops
* Proactively identify gaps, discrepancies, and opportunities in the data, and communicate findings in a way that drives action, not just awareness
* Own prioritization of your analytics roadmap: scope requests, push back when needed, and make transparent tradeoffs about where your time goes

**Nice to Have**

* Translating developer behavior into product insights
* A/B testing and experimentation design
* Revenue modeling and forecasting
